title: Four workers add up their gradients
notes: Four gradients: (3, 1, 4, 1), (5, 9, 2, 6), (5, 3, 5, 8) and (9, 7, 9, 3). In the first step worker 1 sends its a (3) to worker 2, which adds it: 5 + 3 = 8. After three steps each worker owns one finished chunk; three more and every worker holds (22, 20, 20, 18). Each sent 6 chunks, 1.5 vectors' worth.
